rules: Use only access explicitly permitted to the later job; never bypass authentication, paywalls, robots controls, or other access restrictions.
Treat every catalog URL as an unverified pointer until the target is retrieved and classified.
Record the requested URL, resolved URL, retrieval outcome, retrieval time, content hash, media type, access conditions, and license when known.
Preserve failed retrieval evidence instead of converting a failure into an availability claim.
Keep retrieved content out of student-safe views until provenance, license, officiality, and leakage checks pass.
Do not promote a normalized resource record to an official unit solely because it is normalized or source-labeled official.
recommended_order: Verify the official course website and locate a syllabus or schedule.
Inventory textbook and recording coverage without assuming their ordering matches the syllabus.
Locate and validate assignment bodies and their dependencies.
Register later units only after their required materials and validation boundaries are explicit.
